description:
Description

This is a Notice of Intent (NOI) and is not a request for proposals or quotations. A solicitation will not be issued.

The National Institutes of Health (NIH), Clinical Center, Office of Purchasing and Contracts, on behalf of the Patient Support Services Department (PSSD), intends to award a sole source Firm-Fixed-Price Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract to:

Deep Ocean Films
23024 Meadow Mist Road
Clarksburg, MD 20871

This acquisition is conducted in accordance with FAR 6.302-1 – Only One Responsible Source.

Requirement

The contractor shall provide highly specialized medical/scientific photography services in support of NIH research and clinical operations.

Services include photography of patient conditions, surgical specimens, and scientific documentation using specialized techniques and equipment.

Period of Performance

Base Year: April 1, 2026 – March 31, 2027
Option Year 1: April 1, 2027 – March 31, 2028
Option Year 2: April 1, 2028 – March 31, 2029
Option Year 3: April 1, 2029 – March 31, 2030

Justification

Deep Ocean Films is the only vendor capable due to specialized expertise in medical/scientific photography and familiarity with NIH clinical workflows.

Interested Parties

Interested vendors may submit capability statements demonstrating their ability to meet the requirement.

Submission Instructions

Point of Contact: Shasheshe Goolsby
Email: shasheshe.goolsby@nih.gov

Responses must be submitted by March 30, 2026 at 1030AMEST.
